title: Danish Government Scholarships under the Cultural Agreements
provider: Danish Ministry of Higher Education and Science
field: All fields (also Danish language and culture)
description: Scholarships offered to citizens of countries with which Denmark has a cultural agreement, for a period of study or research at a Danish institution, or for summer courses in Danish language and culture.
amount: Monthly stipend and, in some cases, a tuition contribution and travel support

title: Danish State Tuition Fee Waivers and Scholarships
provider: Danish universities (state-funded, Ministry of Higher Education and Science)
description: A limited number of government-funded scholarships that Danish universities award to highly qualified students from outside the EU/EEA, given as a full or partial tuition fee waiver and sometimes a grant towards living costs.
amount: Full or partial tuition fee waiver, occasionally with a living-cost grant

title: University of Copenhagen Danish Government Scholarship
description: Government-funded scholarship that the University of Copenhagen awards to the most talented non-EU/EEA applicants to a full master's programme, covering tuition and part of living costs.
amount: Full tuition fee waiver plus a monthly stipend towards living expenses

title: Aarhus University Scholarships
description: State-funded scholarships awarded by Aarhus University to outstanding applicants from outside the EU/EEA, given as a tuition fee waiver with a limited number also including a grant.
amount: Full or partial tuition fee waiver, some with a living-cost grant

title: Technical University of Denmark (DTU) PhD Scholarships
description: Salaried PhD positions advertised on a rolling basis by DTU departments, open to applicants of any nationality holding a relevant master's degree.
amount: Employment contract with a salary set by the Danish collective agreement, plus pension and social security
